work_item.role: W1 public-evidence discovery and neutral admission

discovery_pass.method: Direction-blind inspection of the pinned Coding Agent Bench study code and its public CodingBenchmarkResults bucket. Admission is limited to Gemma main-grid harness rows whose exact thinking-on n=250 pass@1 values are explicitly published by the primary bucket README and whose historical harness versions are pinned in the study repository. Secondary-review values are not used for admission.
discovery_pass.source_main_grid: 10 harnesses x 2 models x 250 held-out SWE-bench Pro tasks x one rollout = 5000 published rollouts
discovery_pass.admitted_surface: 8 Gemma 4 26B-A4B thinking-on rows with exact primary-published n=250 values

source_known_dimensions: same Gemma 4 26B-A4B model label and BF16 main-grid precision
same google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it serve identity in pinned study code
thinking enabled for the admitted main-grid regime
same 262144 context length and 32768 max output in pinned Gemma serve configuration
same 250 held-out SWE-bench Pro tasks with one rollout per task
agent and grading execute inside the benchmark image
raw rollout artifacts are public, including scores, token-usage logs, exact launch command, stdout and graded patches/transcripts
historical harness package/binary versions are pinned by the study code
explicit_unknown_or_nonidentical_dimensi: exact Gemma model repository revision/checkpoint hash
exact vLLM image digest used by the published sweep because the pinned script defaults to a latest tag
exact upstream SWE-bench Pro dataset/runner revision used to materialize the frozen held-out set
persistent harness-side state outside released rollout artifacts
harness-native prompts, tools, context management and stopping behavior differ by the independent variable and are not normalized by W1
canonical OpenSiro linkage is absent for mini-swe-agent, Crush, Qwen Code and Goose

non_admission_dispositions.reason: The primary bucket README confirms Hermes is part of the ten-harness main grid but does not publish its exact Gemma pass@1 value in the exact-value table inspected by W1. No secondary-derived value is substituted.

The primary bucket README confirms OpenClaw is part of the ten-harness main grid but does not publish its exact Gemma pass@1 value in the exact-value table inspected by W1. No secondary-derived value is substituted.

The primary README publishes the grid and range but not the complete exact per-harness GLM table. W1 does not import exact rows from a secondary evidence review without row-level primary verification.

The source labels this as an unfinished partial arm: only 8 harnesses and uneven 86-191 task denominators rather than the complete 250-task grid. It remains a separate ablation lead and is not merged into the main-grid observations.

commands_required: python scripts/admission_check.py <each of the eight new raw records>
